definitions.explanation: A difficult obstacle or challenge that is hard to overcome. Commonly used for competitive exams, university admissions, and difficult stages in a process.

examples.japanese: ⟦{最大|さいだい}→最大：04827_saidai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{難関|なんかん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{突破|とっぱ}した→突破する：25363_toppasuru⟧。
examples.english: We broke through the biggest hurdle.

examples.japanese: {難関|なんかん}{大学|だいがく}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{合格|ごうかく}する→合格する：27949_goukakusuru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{簡単|かんたん}→簡単：00713_kantan⟧で⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧。
examples.english: Getting into a prestigious university is not easy.

examples.japanese: ⟦{面接|めんせつ}→面接：01100_mensetsu⟧⟦{試験|しけん}→試験：01422_shiken⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{最後|さいご}→最後：01413_saigo⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{難関|なんかん}だった⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、なん⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧⟦{乗|の}り{越|こ}えた→乗り越える：04620_norikoeru⟧。
examples.english: The interview was the final hurdle, but I managed to get through it.

notes:
USAGE:
{難関|なんかん} is frequently used as a modifier: {難関|なんかん}{大学|だいがく} (prestigious/competitive university), {難関|なんかん}⟦{試験|しけん}→試験：01422_shiken⟧ (difficult exam), {難関|なんかん}⟦{資格|しかく}→資格：02834_shikaku⟧ (difficult qualification). It implies something that requires considerable effort to overcome.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {難関|なんかん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{突破|とっぱ}する→突破する：25363_toppasuru⟧ (to break through a barrier)
- {難関|なんかん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{乗|の}り{越|こ}える→乗り越える：04620_norikoeru⟧ (to overcome a hurdle)
- {難関|なんかん}{大学|だいがく} (competitive/elite university)
- {難関|なんかん}⟦{試験|しけん}→試験：01422_shiken⟧ (difficult exam)
